reason: Both reach the same diagnosis: net activated users are flat, the reward fires at signup, and the fix is to pay on activation. A also covers the KPI change to cost per activated user and incremental activated users, referrer concentration and segmentation, and the cohort-age measurement artifact. B has a useful organic-drop caveat, but it overstates "100% zero-intent signups" and omits the KPI and referrer-segmentation points.
